name: kensigline
description: Kensigline: API (backend) + React UI (frontend). Run from repo root.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
